verdict.rationale: Rootly's AI Summaries generate titles, summaries, catchups, and status write-ups from the incident's record during the incident, so 'nobody has to write documentation mid-incident'. Meeting Scribe joins bridges automatically and transcribes them live with speaker labels, attached to the incident. missing for 10: detailed documentation of AI-drafted stakeholder/status updates beyond a one-line 'status write-ups' mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of live summary and scribe quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing

citations.quote: Titles, summaries, catchups, and status write-ups, generated from the incident's own record so nobody has to write documentation mid-incident.
AI Summaries writes it for you, from what the incident already knows: metadata, alerts, timeline events, action items, and (when permitted) Slack messages and meeting transcripts.
The scribe joins your incident bridges, transcribes them live with speaker labels, and turns the call into a record your whole team can use.
Meeting Scribe joins the bridge automatically and preserves the call as a live, searchable, speaker-labeled record attached to the incident.
Incident catchup: The summary, expanded and delivered privately to responders joining midstream.
